t: Forge Steel portable vice provides secure workpiece clamping for a range of workshop tasks. Constructed from robust cast iron, the compact vice features a 360° swivel base for adaptable positioning and easier access to materials. Ideal for metalwork, woodworking, and various DIY projects where a reliable hold is crucial. Provides a 58mm max. jaw opening, and a clamping force of 1225N, to ensure stability for diverse workpieces. Offers a versatile addition to any workbench or job site.
b: Mounts To Surfaces Up To 65mm Thick
